style_authority.note: Opens with a 'Reading this as' read of a frequent-use calm utility operations sheet and ties the 480 ms ease-in settle to that context. Component role (draggable workspace, 'not a push button') is used to reject press scaling.

reference_selection.note: Visibly applies interaction-physics guidance (critical-damped spring, velocity handoff, projection horizon, bounded rubber-band) and a validation plan, but never names which references were selected, so credit is withheld for implicit selection.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Section 2 answers 'Yes, selectively' and lists what must not animate (transition: all, whole-sheet shrink, content/focus, overshoot under Reduced Motion); explicitly avoids bounce for a utility surface.

evidence_level.note: Labels evidence as 'static code plus product context' and states runtime consequences 'remain hypotheses'; F3 says layout animation adds 'performance risk, not proven dropped frames'.

verified_boundary.note: Separate Verified/Unverified lists cover lag, frame rate, focus behavior and accessibility; repairs are flagged 'not tested fixes' and Reduced Motion/interruption are deferred to the validation plan.

design_moves.note: Eight moves cover handle-only press feedback, single translateY owner with capture and grab offset, presentation-value interruption, measured velocity into a spring, conditional projection formula, bounded rubber-band, and a Reduced Motion path. Hysteresis is not addressed.

scope_control.note: 78 lines, exactly five blockers and eight moves, all within motion behavior and validation; the dense finding table is slightly heavy but priorities stay clear.
